sprints.name: Foundation and Walking Skeleton
sprints.goal: Stand up the tenant-aware platform skeleton, baseline auth, queue intake, UI shell, and delivery pipeline.

tickets.title: Scaffold mono-repo service layout
tickets.description: Create api, worker, web, and viewer-ready data package skeleton with shared configs.

tickets.title: Create tenant and identity schema baseline
tickets.description: Model workspaces, users, roles, queues, and session tables with migration strategy.

tickets.title: Implement queue and ticket walking skeleton
tickets.description: Expose health, auth bootstrap, queue list, and basic ticket create/read endpoints.

tickets.title: Build support workspace shell
tickets.description: Create dashboard shell, navigation, queue list view, and shared design tokens.

tickets.title: Add CI, Docker, and quality gates
tickets.description: Wire lint, typecheck, tests, build, and Docker Compose for local and CI usage.

sprints.name: Intake, Routing, and SLA Control
sprints.goal: Ship ticket intake channels, metadata normalization, routing rules, SLA timers, and queue operations dashboards.

tickets.title: Build multichannel ticket intake adapters
tickets.description: Support email, web form, chat simulation, and API ingestion with idempotency keys.

tickets.title: Extend ticket schema for timeline and metadata
tickets.description: Add attachments, custom fields, tags, language, sentiment, account tier, and immutable timeline events.

tickets.title: Implement routing and SLA policy engine
tickets.description: Classify tickets, assign queues, compute first-response and resolution timers, and flag breach risk.

tickets.title: Deliver queue workspace and SLA views
tickets.description: Show queue cards, priority lanes, breach risk badges, and agent assignment actions.

tickets.title: Create intake and routing test packs
tickets.description: Add unit, integration, and curl scenarios for normalization, idempotency, and SLA timers.

tickets.title: Log AI telemetry envelope fields
tickets.description: Capture model version, template id, latency, token usage, sources, and human outcome for every AI event.

tickets.title: Publish viewer backlog and flow seeds
tickets.description: Generate backlog JSON, intake flow graphs, and SLA state data for viewer validation.

sprints.name: Agent Workspace and AI Assist
sprints.goal: Enable grounded AI summaries and reply drafting with required human review and approval-safe outbound flows.

tickets.title: Assemble unified ticket context service
tickets.description: Aggregate customer history, entitlements, incidents, related tickets, and recent telemetry into one API.

tickets.title: Design high-risk AI planning and policy checks
tickets.description: Add planner-first validation for refunds, policy exceptions, and high-risk reply suggestions.

tickets.title: Build grounded reply composer
tickets.description: Show summaries, draft replies, confidence band, citations, warnings, and rewrite actions in the agent workspace.

tickets.title: Add approval workflow for outbound replies
tickets.description: Route selected replies to managers for approval before send and enforce draft-only AI responses.

tickets.title: Implement approved knowledge retrieval index
tickets.description: Index runbooks, macros, and help articles for citation-backed AI suggestions.

tickets.title: Create AI assist policy and regression tests
tickets.description: Test human review gates, citation rendering, approval rules, and latency budgets.

tickets.title: Package AI assist viewer artifacts
tickets.description: Add architecture, flow, and screen data for AI draft lifecycle and approval states.

sprints.name: Knowledge, Automation, and Escalations
sprints.goal: Operationalize approved knowledge, automation rules, escalations, collaboration, and admin AI controls.

tickets.title: Ship knowledge lifecycle workflows
tickets.description: Support article drafts, approvals, ownership, review dates, categories, and stale content flags.

tickets.title: Create macro and canned response admin UI
tickets.description: Provide CRUD views, usage stats, and guardrails for macros and canned replies.

tickets.title: Build automation rule engine with dry-run
tickets.description: Execute event and scheduled rules, block recursion, and write conflict and execution logs.

tickets.title: Implement escalations and collaboration
tickets.description: Support specialist handoffs, internal notes, mentions, watchers, and checklist tasks.

tickets.title: Add queue-level AI control settings
tickets.description: Allow admins to disable AI by queue, channel, or action type with audit coverage.

tickets.title: Create integration and webhook framework
tickets.description: Connect CRM, billing, incident tooling, and outbound automation hooks.

tickets.title: Expand knowledge and automation QA suites
tickets.description: Cover dry-run logs, escalation transitions, AI disable rules, and webhook retries.

sprints.name: QA, Compliance, and Analytics
sprints.goal: Deliver QA sampling, audit visibility, operational analytics, privacy tooling, and production-grade accessibility and performance.

tickets.title: Implement QA sampling and scorecards
tickets.description: Sample resolved tickets by policy and score accuracy, empathy, compliance, and completeness.

tickets.title: Build audit log explorer
tickets.description: Expose prompt, output, approval, workflow, latency, and override events with tenant-safe filters.

tickets.title: Launch analytics dashboards and exports
tickets.description: Show backlog, SLA, reopen, escalation, QA, and AI acceptance metrics with filters and exports.

tickets.title: Schedule recurring ops summaries
tickets.description: Generate and deliver daily and weekly summaries to managers and analysts.

tickets.title: Implement privacy retention and redaction controls
tickets.description: Add retention schedules, export/delete flows, and PII redaction in logs and telemetry.

tickets.title: Complete accessibility and performance hardening
tickets.description: Meet WCAG 2.1 AA for core flows and hold p95 workspace, search, and AI latency targets.

sprints.name: Production Readiness and Launch
sprints.goal: Finish enterprise auth, deployment hardening, observability, recovery, and launch validation artifacts.

tickets.title: Integrate SSO, SAML, and MFA policies
tickets.description: Support enterprise identity flows, role sync, and session hardening for admin-controlled tenants.

tickets.title: Finalize AWS-compatible deployment topology
tickets.description: Publish IaC-ready service topology, autoscaling, backups, and storage controls.

tickets.title: Add health views, traces, and alerts
tickets.description: Track queue lag, SLA breach spikes, AI latency, webhook failures, and auth errors.

tickets.title: Write staging and rollback runbooks
tickets.description: Document deploy checks, smoke tests, rollback triggers, and recovery drills.

tickets.title: Execute launch verification suite
tickets.description: Run load, security, integration, and release packaging checks before launch.

tickets.title: Assemble executive viewer validation pack
tickets.description: Publish final viewer data, sprint metrics, diagrams, and review checklist for stakeholder signoff.

bugs.title: Prevent recursive automation cascade on status updates
bugs.notes: Validate loop guards when rules update tickets that trigger sibling rules.

bugs.title: Reopen window should ignore merged child replies
bugs.notes: Merged child tickets cannot create outbound or reopen parent without correction flow.

bugs.title: Redact billing account numbers from audit export
bugs.notes: Applies to prompt logs, webhook payload snapshots, and CSV exports.
